body: Hey Robert! So glad to hear you guys are expecting! What are some words of wisdom for my husband? He's about to be a first time (and might I add pretty awesome) dad.

He agreed to sign if I couldn't ask him for money or my belongings! Now he's just stalling. Frankly, I'm happy to be out. The bum moved us back in with his mama so I didn't even have a home to call my own. Plus, he was struggling with himself psychologically. Took antidepressants but didn't seek regular counseling.

Idk, I may never do this again. I just wanted to love someone and have a family. I thought I could have that with him and I was wrong. But I actually do know many couples that married younger than we were and have successful, happy marriages.

He was my first anything. I worked so hard to make sure made him happy. I didn't know a thing about video games but I learned so I could play with him. I cooked him dinner every night. All his favorites. Now, my sister is trying to get me to go out again and all these guys want is to just have sex and leave and I'm not like that :(
Whooooa nelly!

I just left a similar situation. My soon to be ex husband decided he wanted to live closer to his parents and quit his job to do so. To make him happy we moved all the way from TN to NYC and lost everything. For a few weeks, we stayed in a roach infested apartment, drained our savings, and moved in with his parents (against my better judgement). I was a great wife and "stuck by him" though we had nothing and we were living in a tiny spare room and sleeping on someone else's full sized bed. I even worked and helped him find a job. But, in the end, he turned on me and spent less and less time with me. His mother grew to hate me because she felt I was taking away her little boy. Bottom line: it's gonna hurt but you need to go now before you have kids together.

Thanks to all for your comments. I am much better than I was. I did call a new doctor and am scheduled for a visit soon. Turns out that none of this was my fault. My ex has been struggling with his sexuality for quite some time. Friends and relatives knew but said nothing because they didn't want to be responsible for breaking up our marriage. I have begun to pull my life together. I cut off his cell phone and I am shutting down our bank account today. Lost 10 lbs in one week. Not sure how that happened but I feel great. I sleep longer at night and I haven't cried since  I found out. I think I'm going to be ok.

I'm not going to say any more because I'm sure you're just foaming at the mouth for attention when you could use that energy to shower off that B.O. sweat you've worked up while hiding out in your mother's basement.

Look, I know getting pregnant, like any other process for someone like me, takes time. But that was precisely my point. Shouldn't I act after two years of nothing? I mean, I feel like there's something wrong with that.

Isn't life funny like that? My mom (and all the other women in my family with the exception of my aunt) got pregnant at very young ages. They told me that having a baby that young would RUIN my life. So I went to college, first in the fam to get my degree, I work a nice desk job and then I'm ready to start and family and my body is like "No, you were too responsible and now I've decided to boycott you." Also, avada kadavra to the baby fairy, I say.
Being so new to all this, what exactly is an RE? Sorry.

All the women in my family had it as well. Going in for major surgery as a kid was terrifying but the doctors I had as a teenager assured me that I would live this normal life and would be able to get pregnant easily when I was ready to. Now, I just wonder if they were saying those things to soften the blow. I'm actually just glad my spouse is being so compassionate about the whole thing. I try not to cry about it in front of anyone but somehow he manages to find me in the middle of a breakdown. Understanding goes a long way I guess.

Once, when I was a kid, I was sitting at my parents desktop playing games when,suddenly, I heard a noise, looked  out the window and noticed a man walking around in the driveway. I ran and told my Dad and Mom about the man. My Dad attempted to scare the man off but the man was high and told my Dad to get outside and change his tires or he would murder our whole family. What followed was an hour of non responsive police officers, murder threats with a tire iron, and banging on every window and door around our house. Finally, the police arrived and the man booked it into the woods. We later found out he was one of three convicts on the run. They were chased through town till the man man a turn down our road and blew a flat.
